paragraphs.text: An Amadeus-inspired theme and interface accents for DeepSeek Harness.
# DSH Amadeus Skin
简体中文
A local DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web theme bundle, independent of the Amadeus workbench.
> **Artwork rights:** The Amadeus image is sourced from Yink/Amadeus, but its provenance and permiss
ion to use or redistribute are unverified. No authorization is claimed or guaranteed; verify rights
before use or distribution. The MIT code license does not cover third-party artwork, which is also e
mbedded in `client.js`. See ASSETS.md.
## Features
- Dark crimson, black and warm gold palette; light wine-colored palette also available. Dark mode is

recommended.
- Theme overrides for text, backgrounds, code syntax, links and buttons, with static t

erminal ornaments and Amadeus marks in the sidebar, welcome area and composer.
- Does not read chat
content, change the model or require a network connection. Decorations are not status indicators.
## Installation
### Plugin market (only if listed)
If this bundle becomes available in your configured DSH plugin market, find it there and install it
using the market's install action. Availability is not guaranteed; otherwise use the local method be
g the market's install action. Availability is not guaranteed; otherwise use the local method below.
### Manual local install
1. Obtain the complete bundle directory locally. Its package is private (`@local/dsh-amadeus-skin`);

it is not an npm publication.
2. In DSH, ask the agent to call `plugin_manager` with `action: "inst
all_bundle"` and `target` set to the **absolute path to the bundle directory** (the directory contai
ning `package.json`), not a relative path or an individual file. For example, use your own path in `
{"action":"install_bundle","target":"C:\\path\\to\\dsh-amadeus-skin"}` (or an absolute POSIX path).
3. Installation affects every session in the current profile. Check for an existing bundle with the
same name before replacing it. Enable the bundle and plugin if necessary and select dark mode in App
earance. Check the installation's application result and warnings: installation does not guarantee a

ctivation, and replacing loaded modules may require restarting DSH.
4. Disable or uninstall the bund
le to remove it from the profile. Other active themes may affect its appearance.
## Build and test
Node.js is required; no package installation is needed. From this directory:

Rebuild after changing `client.source.js` or `amadeus-logo.png`: the build generates `client.js` wit
h the image embedded. Tests run in a simulated environment and do not verify the live UI.
## Compatibility
Designed for the DSH web client. No supported version range has been established; future DSH changes
may break the skin. Some theme variables depend on implementation details, and shared tokens can af
fect other components or themes. Check rendering, interactions and contrast in your DSH version; aut
omated tests are not visual or accessibility certification.
